steps.en: Point it at the model to decensor
Loads the weights and derives a per-layer refusal direction from good/bad prompts
steps.zh: 加载权重，用无害／有害提示词算出每一层的拒答方向

steps.en: Runs ~200 abliteration trials, scoring refusals and KL divergence
steps.zh: 跑约 200 轮消融试验，给拒答率和 KL 散度打分

steps.en: Pick a point on the Pareto front
steps.zh: 在帕累托前沿上挑一个点

steps.en: Exports the merged model or a LoRA adapter
steps.zh: 导出合并后的模型或 LoRA 适配器

value.en: A locally runnable decensored checkpoint — no training data, no abliteration script
value.zh: 一个能在本地跑的去审查检查点——不用准备训练数据，不用自己写消融脚本
